examples.text: А вы не пойдёте с нами?
examples.trans: Are you not coming with us?

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary
meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Не надо знать, надо просто подумать.
examples.trans: You do not need to know, you just need to think.

examples.text: Надо просто хорошо подумать.
examples.trans: You just need to think it over well.

examples.text: Надо его обязательно с кем-нибудь познакомить.
examples.trans: We definitely need to introduce him to someone.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to lie', paired with 'соврать'.

examples.text: Хотя я сам отвезу её врачу.
examples.trans: Although I will take her to the doctor myself.

examples.text: Я сам отвезу её врачу.
examples.trans: I will take her to the doctor myself.

examples.text: Врач сказал, что всё в порядке.
examples.trans: The doctor said that everything is fine.

meanings.en: actually, strictly speaking, as a matter of fact
meanings.note: Prefix 'во-' ('into, up') marks inward or upward movement (stem 'обще-то'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Вообще-то я ещё ничего не решил.
examples.trans: Actually, I have not decided anything yet.

examples.text: Вообще-то я его немного сам доработал.
examples.trans: Actually, I improved it a little myself.

examples.text: Вообще-то Никита пока ещё не знает.
examples.trans: Actually, Nikita does not know yet.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'for now', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Спокойной тебе ночи и сладких снов.
examples.trans: Good night to you and sweet dreams.

examples.text: Легко обойдусь, ты даже не беспокойся!
examples.trans: I will manage easily, do not even worry!

examples.text: Вот ты пойди и спокойно выясни.
examples.trans: Well you go and calmly find out.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'else/more', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Вообще-то я ещё ничего не решил.
examples.trans: Actually, I have not decided anything yet.

examples.text: Как это ты ещё не решил?
examples.trans: What do you mean you have not decided yet?

examples.text: Я ещё ничего не решил.
examples.trans: I have not decided anything yet.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'knows'.

examples.text: Я прекрасно знаю, кто вы такой.
examples.trans: I know very well who you are.

examples.text: Работать главным шеф-поваром, я не знаю.
examples.trans: To work as head chef, I do not know.

examples.text: Не надо знать, надо просто подумать.
examples.trans: You do not need to know, you just need to think.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'he', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Нам пора наконец перестать так прятаться.
examples.trans: It is time for us to finally stop hiding like this.

examples.text: Конечно, ведь сегодня мы идём в кино.
examples.trans: Of course, since today we are going to the cinema.

examples.text: Добрый вечер, вам что-то не понравилось?
examples.trans: Good evening, did you dislike something?

meanings.note: Common neuter noun meaning 'in the morning' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Доброе утро, уважаемая Элеонора Андреевна!
examples.trans: Good morning, respected Eleonora Andreyevna!

examples.text: Он утром улетел в долгую командировку.
examples.trans: He flew away on a long business trip this morning.

examples.text: Доброе утро!
examples.trans: Good morning!

улететь.gloss: to fly away, to depart by plane

meanings.en: to fly away, to fly out, to depart by air
meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'лететь'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to fly away, to depart by plane', paired with 'улетать'.

examples.text: Он утром улетел в долгую командировку.
examples.trans: He flew away on a long business trip this morning.

examples.text: Как ты не улетела?
examples.trans: What do you mean you didn't fly out?

examples.text: Наш самолёт уже улетел.
examples.trans: Our plane has already flown out.

meanings.note: Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'лгий'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('long, lengthy').

examples.text: Не советую, оно готовится очень долго.
examples.trans: I do not advise it, it takes a very long time to prepare.

examples.text: Нехорошо заставлять красивую даму долго ждать.
examples.trans: It is not nice to make a beautiful lady wait a long time.

examples.text: Он утром улетел в долгую командировку.
examples.trans: He flew away on a long business trip this morning.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'business trip' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Он утром улетел в долгую командировку.
examples.trans: He flew away on a long business trip this morning.

examples.text: На кухне отеля всегда есть командировка.
examples.trans: In the hotel kitchen there is always business trip.
